summary: Iteration 3: tested all 7 new features (backend + UI). Backend 41/42 pytest pass (new file test_iteration3_features.py + regression suite). Verified office-day logic (unit + data consistency on 200 leads), overview day block == /api/leads counts, attendance GET/PUT + allocation skipping off BDMs (UI: marked 8 BDMs off, Run now -> lead assigned to Muskaan only), cron 401/200/dedupe by X-Webhook-Id, WhatsApp digest (MOCKED outbox, 9 cards, counts match /api/followups, phone shown after Team blur save), campaign report math + filter, follow-up Done dialog with next date + note (timeline text correct), profile change-password on TEMP user (wrong current / mismatch / success / re-login), BDM 403 on new APIs and page redirects to /overview. Only failure: cron endpoints return 400 when POSTed with no body.

minor.issue: With a valid bearer but EMPTY body, request.json() raises and the endpoint returns 400 'Invalid body'. If the platform cron POSTs without a JSON body, the 9:55 allocation and 10:00 digest never run. Fix: read raw body and treat empty/invalid as {} (still ack 2xx).
Lines use f'+{phone}' but many lead phones are 10-digit without country code (e.g. +8130918825, +7291019124) -> invalid numbers in the message. Prefix 91 when len==10.

Overdue list sorted ascending and capped at 10 -> BDM sees the oldest (Oct) overdue patients, not the most recent. Also, if a BDM is marked off after the digest was prepared, their stale outbox entry for today is not removed.

assigned_on is set to today on every bdm patch (incl. setting Unassigned or re-setting same BDM), which inflates 'Assigned today' and consumes daily quota. Only set when bdm actually changes to a non-empty value.
today's load counts_by({'assigned_on': today}) lacks is_test:False filter (allocation GET uses it) - minor inconsistency.
Existing JWTs remain valid after password change (no token invalidation). Low priority.

rca of the issue: Cron 400: cron_accept calls `await request.json()` and maps ValueError (JSONDecodeError on empty body) to HTTP 400. Reproduce: curl -X POST $URL/api/cron/whatsapp-digest -H 'Authorization: Bearer <secret>' (no body) -> 400 {'detail':'Invalid body'}. Mitigation: `raw = await request.body(); body = json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}` inside try, default {} on error.
